One-click install for Claude Desktop.

## New

- **`wefact-mcp.mcpb` — Claude Desktop extension**, attached below. Download it and double-click (or Claude Desktop → Settings → Extensions → Advanced settings → Install Extension…). Claude asks for your WeFact API key during setup and stores it securely — no venv, no `pip install`, no JSON config. All Python dependencies are bundled.

  Requirements: **Windows with Python 3.14** installed (Claude Desktop bundles Node.js but not Python). Other platforms or Python versions: build your own bundle with `python packaging/build_mcpb.py` after adjusting `PLATFORM` / `PYTHON_VERSION` at the top, or use the [manual install](https://github.com/BE-Zizoo/wefact-mcp#install).

- The release workflow now builds and attaches the extension automatically on every release (`packaging/build_mcpb.py`).

No changes to the server or tools since v1.0.1.
